title: System Operations & Workflow Diagram
prompt:
Design a comprehensive, high-fidelity visual System Operations & Workflow Diagram screen for the CloudHost platform titled 'End-to-End System Operational Workflow'.
Show the complete 12-step operational lifecycle clearly organized into 4 distinct phases with a clean timeline and cards layout:

Phase 1: Admin Onboarding & Provisioning (Steps 1 to 4)
- Step 1: Admin Authentication (Actor: Admin [Crown/Shield icon]) - Admin securely logs into Enterprise SuperAdmin console with MFA.
- Step 2: User Creation & Tier Allocation (Actor: Admin [User-Plus icon]) - Admin provisions tenant profile ('alex@hyperlink.dev') and assigns Hosting Package ('Cloud Business Tier'). [Connecting arrow labeled 'creates & allocates']
- Step 3: Domain Assignment (Actor: Admin [Globe icon]) - Admin binds apex domain 'apexdesign.io' to tenant container. [Connecting arrow labeled 'assigns domain']
- Step 4: Authoritative DNS Zone Configuration (Actor: Admin [Network/DNS icon]) - Admin generates records (A, MX, CNAME, SPF, DKIM, DMARC) with Anycast propagation. [Connecting arrow labeled 'configures records']

Phase 2: Tenant Activation & Identity (Steps 5 to 6)
- Step 5: Secure Credential Dispatch (Actor: System/Server [Server/Mail icon]) - Automated transactional email dispatches temporary login password & portal URL. [Connecting arrow labeled 'dispatches credentials']
- Step 6: Tenant Portal Login (Actor: User [Key/User icon]) - User logs into Client Portal, sets initial password, and accesses tenant dashboard. [Connecting arrow labeled 'authenticates']

Phase 3: Service Utilization & Automatic Provisioning (Steps 7 to 10)
- Step 7: Mailbox Creation Request (Actor: User [Mail-Plus icon]) - User creates email account 'alex@apexdesign.io' with custom quota slider within package limits. [Connecting arrow labeled 'requests mailbox']
- Step 8: Automatic Server Provisioning (Actor: System/Server [Cpu/Terminal icon]) - Dovecot/Postfix backend automatically provisions virtual mailbox directory, TLS cert, and database records in real-time. [Connecting arrow labeled 'provisions automatically']
- Step 9: Webmail & Client Access (Actor: User [Inbox/Send icon]) - User launches Roundcube Webmail or connects IMAP/SMTP client to send/receive mail. [Connecting arrow labeled 'accesses webmail']
- Step 10: Self-Service Security Management (Actor: User [Lock/Key icon]) - User resets mailbox passwords, configures forwarding rules, or modifies vacation auto-responders. [Connecting arrow labeled 'manages settings']

Phase 4: Scaling & Resource Lifecycle (Steps 11 to 12)
- Step 11: Quota Limit & Upgrade Request (Actor: User [Trending-Up icon]) - Storage or mailbox threshold reached (e.g. 90% quota); user selects 'Cloud Pro' tier and submits upgrade request. [Connecting arrow labeled 'submits upgrade']
- Step 12: Admin Approval & Dynamic Expansion (Actor: Admin / System [Check-Circle icon]) - Admin approves request via one-click dashboard or instant Stripe webhook executes auto-upgrade, expanding NVMe storage and mailbox limits instantly.

Layout & Design:
- Top breadcrumbs: 'System Architecture & Operations > End-to-End Workflow Diagram'
- Actor Legend header: Admin (Navy Blue badge #1F3864), User/Tenant (Teal/Emerald badge), System/Server Automation (Indigo/Purple badge) with clear icon badges.
- Horizontal/vertical timeline grid with connecting pipeline paths, step badges (01 to 12), clear status tags ('Automated', 'Manual Admin', 'Tenant Action'), technical payload snippets (e.g., 'POST /api/v1/mailboxes', '200 OK Provisioned'), and interactive zoom/filter toggles ('All Steps', 'Admin Only', 'User Only', 'Automated Only').
- Matches {{DATA:DESIGN_SYSTEM:DESIGN_SYSTEM_1}} with crisp border radii, subtle drop shadows, and clean modern typography.
